Question: A rectangular box measures \(a \times b \times c,\) where \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) are integers and \(1 \le a \le b \le c.\) The volume and the surface area of the box are numerically equal. How many ordered triples \((a, b, c)\) are possible?
